title: Replicating Activation Probing for Sycophancy on Vision-Language Models

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: VLMs are rapidly deployed and visual sycophancy is underexplored. Confirming probing transfers to VLMs extends monitoring coverage. However, the safety impact is somewhat speculative since visual sycophancy severity is not well-characterized.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires constructing a novel sycophantic VLM dataset (image+text pairs), running a VLM (Qwen-VL-7B is large), and extracting activations from a multimodal model. Dataset creation and multimodal activation extraction are both challenging for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Novel dataset creation, VLM inference, activation extraction from multimodal architecture, probe training. Multiple novel components with no existing codebase to build on. Too broad for 30 hours.
